name: Tameeni Insurance
note: Not rated: Tameeni is a flagship subsidiary of Rasan Information Technology, listed on the Saudi Exchange Main Market in June 2024 (30% floated). At the IPO, Saudi VC fund Impact46 was its largest shareholder (18.65% pre-IPO, 13.06% after, per MENAbytes), and the rest sat with founders and the float. Impact46's own site now lists Rasan among its exits ('Rasan's 918M SAR Exit', impact46.sa/about-us), so its current stake is unverified; Rasan publishes no shareholder register, and Impact46's fund LPs are undisclosed, so a possible state-fund 5%+ position cannot be excluded. No human-rights finding found. Present on several Saudi shirts (front/back).
